'''Monique Adolphe''' (23 July 1932 – 27 June 2022) was a French scientist and researcher into the field of [[cell biology]]. She was one of the pioneers of [[cell culture]] ''in vitro'' and its applications in [[alternatives to animal testing]]. She was an ''[[Officier de la Légion d'honneur]]'' and received several other important decorations and distinctions (see below).

==Biography==
Monique Adolphe was born in Paris on 23 July 1932.<ref name="ARMB"/> After her pharmacological internship at the [[Hôtel-Dieu de Paris]] under [[Jean Cheymol]]'s supervision in the 1950s, Monique Adolphe orientated, in 1960, her researches in the field of [[cell culture]]. With [[Paul Lechat]] she was an ardent advocate of alternative methods to [[animal testing]] by promoting the use of ''[[in vitro]]'' techniques, while recognising the limits of these methods.<ref>{{cite web
  | last = 
  | first = 
  | author-link = 
  | title = Tests in vitro, utiles mais pas suffisants: Entretien avec Monique Adolphe
  | work = 
  | publisher = [[Fondation pour la recherche médicale]]
  | date = 2000-04-11
  | url = http://www.frm.org/nos-dossiers/fiches-sante/tests-in-vitro-utiles-mais-pas-suffisants-2.htm
  | doi = 
  | access-date = 2009-05-28}}</ref>

Much of her research career was devoted to the study of [[cartilage]] and [[chondrocyte]] biology.<ref>{{cite news 
  | last = 
  | first = 
  | title = Arthrose: des nouvelles pistes de traitement
  | work = [[Le Figaro]]
  | place =
  | pages = 
  | language = 
  | publisher = 
  | date = 2006-10-27
  | url = http://www.lefigaro.fr/sciences/20061027.FIG000000048_arthrose_des_nouvelles_pistes_de_traitement.html
  | access-date = 2009-05-28}}</ref> As Research Director of the Laboratory of Cellular Pharmacology of the ''[[École pratique des hautes études]]'' until 1997, she trained dozens of young scientists in cell culture methods. In 1986 she founded the ''Société de pharmaco-toxicologie cellulaire'' ("Society of Cellular Pharmaco-Toxicology") (SPTC).

From 1990 to 1994, she was president of the ''École pratique des hautes études''. On 7 January 2009 she became Chair of the ''Académie Nationale de Pharmacie'' ("National Academy of Pharmacy")<ref>{{cite web
  | last = 
  | first = 
  | author-link = 
  | title = Monique Adolphe élue présidente de l’Académie nationale de pharmacie 
  | work = 
  | publisher = My Pharma editions
  | date = 2009-01-05
  | url = http://www.mypharma-editions.com/monique-adolphe-elue-presidente-de-lacademie-nationale-de-pharmacie
  | format = 
  | doi = 
  }}</ref><ref>{{cite web
  | last = 
  | first = 
  | author-link = 
  | title = l'annuaire de l'Académie nationale de pharmacie
  | work = 
  | publisher = Académie Nationale de Pharmacie
  | date = 
  | url = http://www.acadpharm.org/index.php?PAGE=anualpha
  | format = 
  | doi = 
  | access-date = 2009-05-28}}</ref> for one year—the first woman to hold this position since the Academy was created in 1803.

Adolphe died in Paris on 27 June 2022, at the age of 89.<ref>[https://www.ephe.psl.eu/deces-de-monique-adolphe ″Décès de Monique Adolphe″], Press release [[École pratique des hautes études]]/[[Paris Sciences et Lettres University]], June 2022.</ref>

==Honours==
* Member of the [[Académie Nationale de Médecine]] (elected 2001)
* Honorary member of the National Academy of Pharmacy (elected in 1984, Honorary since 2002); Vice-President since March 2008; Chair since January 2009
* Honorary member of the [[European Society of Toxicology In Vitro]]
* Foreign honorary member of the [[:fr:Académie royale de médecine de Belgique|Académie royale de médecine de Belgique]]<ref name="ARMB">{{in lang|fr}} [http://www.armb.be/index.php?id=1376 Monique Adolphe] on the website of the [[:fr:Académie royale de médecine de Belgique|Académie royale de médecine de Belgique]].</ref>
* Honorary President of the Society of cellular pharmaco-toxicology
* Honorary President of the European Society of tissue culture
* Officier de la [[Legion of Honour]]
* Commander of the [[Order of Merit]]<ref>{{cite web
  | last = 
  | first = 
  | author-link = 
  | title = Décret du 16 mai 2008 portant promotion et nomination
  | work = [[Journal Officiel de la République Française]]
  | publisher = [[Légifrance]]
  | date = 2008-05-17
  | url = http://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do;jsessionid=?cidTexte=JORFTEXT000018800905&dateTexte=&oldAction=rechJO
  | format = 
  | doi = 
  | access-date = 2009-05-28}}</ref>
* Commandeur des [[Palmes Académiques]]

*''Culture de cellules animales'', Georgia Barlovatz-Meimon and Monique Adolphe, ed. [[INSERM]], 2003. {{ISBN|2-85598-753-9}}.
